AgentIcon.description:
Agent icon constraints, confirmed by rejection and acceptance during Phase 1.

The upload control accepts PNG only and enforces a hard 100 KB ceiling. A 512 px render of the Raybot logo was 195.8 KB and was rejected outright; the 256 px render was 53.8 KB and was accepted. The ceiling is on encoded file size, not on pixel dimensions, so the practical rule is to downscale until the encoded PNG clears 100 KB.

ConfidenceLevel.description:
How a recorded fact was established.

- `CONFIRMED` - observed directly in the running product: a DOM dump, a   captured network request, or a screenshot showing the resulting state.
- `SOURCE-INSPECTED` - read out of shipped client source (bundle, sourcemap,   or manifest) but never exercised at runtime during the audit.
- `UNCONFIRMED` - inferred from naming, adjacency, or documentation, with no   direct observation behind it.

Raybot uses a single public website source pointed at the Ray documentation. The card types offered by the add-knowledge flow are enumerated here because the set is a closed list in the UI.

MicrosoftIQBinding.description:
A Microsoft IQ (Foundry IQ) knowledge base binding.

The binding points at an Azure AI Search knowledge base created through the `2025-11-01-preview` Search REST surface. The tier constraint is the critical one: knowledge bases hosted on a Free-tier search service never appear in the Copilot Studio picker, regardless of whether they answer correctly over REST.
